name: Twenty-Toed Toad
oracle_text:
Your maximum hand size is twenty.
Whenever you attack with two or more creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and draw a card.
Whenever this creature attacks, you win the game if there are twenty or more counters on it or you have twenty or more cards in hand.
blocked_sentences: Your maximum hand size is twenty.

needs.what: a player-wide static that sets the affected player's maximum hand size to a printed number (here twenty, affects_player: you) while the permanent is on the battlefield, read by the cleanup-step discard (514.1) in place of the fixed MAX_HAND_SIZE
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The closest are the static no_hand_limit and the op no_maximum_hand_size, which remove the limit entirely; the cleanup discard in turn.py compares hand size against the constant MAX_HAND_SIZE (7) with no way to set a different number. Using no_hand_limit would be strictly better than the printed card (no discard above twenty). The other two lines look expressible: a you_attack trigger with a two-or-more-attackers condition doing add_counters +1/+1 on self and draw 1, and an attacks trigger on self with an if over any of cmp counters_on self >= 20 / cards_in_hand you >= 20 then win_game
